constitutional_basis: Article XXVII — every threshold has provenance. Component specs cite commercial part numbers where possible.

segments.function: CSF access from ventricle to manifold
segments.spec: Medical-grade silicone, ID 1.2 mm, OD 2.5 mm, length 8-12 cm (patient-specific)
segments.commercial_reference: Medtronic Codman Certas standard proximal catheter (similar dimensions)
segments.notes: Existing component. No new development needed for bench prototype.

segments.function: Splits CSF from proximal catheter into N=4 segment channels
segments.spec: Bench: machined acrylic block with 4 outlets, each with variable-orifice valve seat. Implantable: medical-grade silicone multi-lumen extrusion.
segments.commercial_reference: Bench: custom machined. Implantable: none — custom extrusion required.
segments.notes: Manifold design is bench-trivial; implantable extrusion is a 6-12 month development task.

segments.spec_bench: Solenoid-actuated pinch valve, N=4, response time <500 ms, 0-100% open in 32 steps
segments.commercial_reference_bench: Takasago RK-1 pinch valve, or equivalent; ~$200/unit, $800 for 4
segments.spec_implantable: MEMS variable orifice, <100 uL volume, <1 mW actuation power, 5-year fatigue life
segments.notes: Bench valve is COTS. Implantable MEMS valve is the single biggest engineering risk.

segments.spec: Medical-grade silicone, ID 1.5 mm, OD 3.0 mm, length 30-50 cm
segments.commercial_reference: Standard distal shunt catheter (Medtronic, Integra, Sophysa)

electronics.spec: ARM Cortex-M0+ class, <1 mW active, 32 kB flash, 8 kB RAM, hardware FPU preferred

electronics.function: Digitizes pressure and flow sensor signals
electronics.commercial_reference: TI ADS1115 (bench) or integrated in MCU (implantable)

electronics.spec: H-bridge per channel, 100 mA drive, current-limited
Primary cell, 3V, 200 mAh, 5-year life at 1 mW average load = 43.8 mWh/year consumed vs 600 mWh capacity. Margin: 13.7x.
electronics.status: EXTERNAL_SOURCE (cell); HYPOTHESIS (hermetic packaging for chronic implant)

software.spec: C on Cortex-M0+, runs 1 Hz loop, implements dual_invariant_allocator (see 04_control_algorithm.json)
software.status: MODELLED (Python reference impl in 05_simulator.py); PORT_TO_C required for implantable

software.spec: Bench: USB serial. Implantable: MICS-band RF telemetry (402-405 MHz), 30 cm range.
software.status: EXTERNAL_SOURCE (bench); HYPOTHESIS (implantable RF — requires FCC/ETSI compliance)

bill_of_materials_bench_v1.summary: 4x pressure sensors + 4x flow sensors + 4x pinch valves + MCU + ADC + manifold + catheters + bench frame
